articles.summary: Acquisition enables McGraw Hill to develop, adapt and bring products to market faster in U.S. and international markets and provide new educator-focused AI solutions to customize McGraw Hill’s trusted curriculum to their unique classroom needs Key Highlights The acquisition will accelerate McGraw Hill’s ability to create trusted K-12 curriculum, and make adaptation, localization and translation even easier for instructional content across the U.S. and international markets. Teachally expands McGraw Hill's educator-first AI solutions with tools that simplify lesson planning and content creation, support instructional customization and help educators personalize McGraw Hill curriculum to their classroom needs with AI tools embedded in the platforms they use and trust. Combining Teachally's AI with McGraw Hill's content and expertise will allow us to expand the subjects, teachers, and students we can serve in more personalized and localized ways. McGraw Hill, Inc. articles.title: McGraw Hill Acquires Teachally to Accelerate K-12 Curriculum Development and Expand AI Tools for Educators
